🔹 Gonstead Extremity Expert | Chiropractic Education | Performance Strategist🔹

Dr. Bobby Fano, DC is redefining modern chiropractic education through the lens of Gonstead extremity mastery. Based in Sarasota, Florida, Dr. Fano bridges over a century of Gonstead precision with today’s biomechanics and clinical innovation. Having delivered over 175,000 specific adjustments, he teaches chiropractors how to analyze, adjust, and correct with certainty and purpose.

This channel is dedicated to doctors who want to elevate their skill set and results through:
⚙️ Gonstead extremity case studies
💪 Adjusting demonstrations
🧠 Biomechanical analysis
🔥 Practice philosophy and growth

Subscribe to become better and experience the evolution of Gonstead Chiropractic Care — with Dr. Bobby Fano.
